prompt:
Our RCIA program needs a knowledge-base entry for new Catholics studying the topic of **purgatory**. The entry will go into our digital self-study library.

Please use the local reference tools available in this workspace to look up the official Church citations and pull in a relevant prayer, then produce a complete, properly formatted reference document saved as **purgatory_answer.md**.

Important context: Purgatory is a topic where different statements by the Church carry different levels of authority — please make sure the document helps learners understand which parts are definitively settled and which are matters of ongoing theological reflection. The audience is adult RCIA candidates who are complete beginners.
